Package net.sourceforge.plantuml.text

Class PythonLine

java.lang.Object
net.sourceforge.plantuml.text.PythonLine
public final class PythonLine extends Object
Tells a legacy preprocessor line from a Python line, by hand (no regex). Every line given here is already known to contain a !; the rules are those of section 6 of PYTHON_PREPROCESSOR.md.

  • Method Details

    • unescapeBang

      public static String unescapeBang(String s)
      The escape of a text line that starts with "!" (section 8 of PYTHON_PREPROCESSOR.md): "!!important" is the text "!important". The first "!" is removed when the line starts, after its blanks, with "!!" not followed by "{" ("!!{" is the escape of an interpolation, which gives "!{" by itself). Any other line is returned as it is.

    • isLegacyAffectation

      public static boolean isLegacyAffectation(String s)
      "!$x = 1", "!local $x = 1" and "!x ?= 1" are legacy. "!x = 1" is not.

    • isStatementLine

      public static boolean isStatementLine(String s)
      The last rule (section 6 of PYTHON_PREPROCESSOR.md): a "!" followed, after optional blanks, by an identifier, a digit, "(" or "[" is Python: "!x = 1", "!x == 1", "!f(1)", "!1 + 1", "!(a, b) = c", "![1, 2]". With blanks ("! x = 1") it is Python code indented by the gutter rule, so an indentation error at the top level. The words of NOT_PYTHON_WORDS are excluded. To be tested after every legacy directive.
